name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Sit upright on a bench with feet planted flat and cup one end of a dumbbell with both palms.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead with your core braced and elbows pointing forward.
Bend both elbows under control to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your elbows smoothly to lift the dumbbell back overhead.
tips: Keep your upper arms near your ears without arching your lower back.
Grip the dumbbell plate securely with both hands and keep your elbows from flaring wide.
